clips.image_reference: Reference Miri and Nim in Image 1 to generate Miri running through a village lane with Nim, a small fox, at her heels, clutching a cloth bundle. The camera tracks alongside them as Nim asks {Is it bread?} Miri replies {No.} Nim asks {Is it bread pretending not to be bread?} Miri stops by a low wall and peeks at three honey-date cakes in the bundle. Miri says {Ima made them for after chores.} Nim asks {And how many cakes?} Miri says {Three.} Nim says {A perfect arrangement. Let no one disturb it.}

clips.image_reference: Reference Ima, Miri, and Nim in Image 1 to generate Ima stepping from her village doorway in the morning with a basket of folded linen as the camera pans toward Miri and Nim. Ima says, {Miri, take these to Saba Elior, please. His old sleeves are more patch than sleeve.} Then, {And if you pass Tav on the way, give him one of the honey cakes.} Miri freezes as Nim, a small fox, turns toward her with wide eyes and says, {Perhaps there are two Tavs. We should confirm before making decisions.} Miri says, {Ima, Tav had a cake yesterday.} Ima replies, {And you have three today.}
